items.title: Chuck Lamb interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, February 7, 2023
items.q: Chris Brubeck is a really great orchestral writer and has been really supportive in that.

ctx.x: You got a record. Did it proceed from there as you hoped or what was it like dealing with a small record label?

Oh it was incredible. Maybe because of the small label thing but you know they just, there was no restrictions musically on what we were doing and there was a lot of freedom in the studio time-wise — just go ahead and make this record. But you know we had been playing — the only way we could make a record was to play live in the studio, which was trickier back then, the technology to do live and not have bleed with instruments and this kind of thing. But we basically played live in the studio and then I did my…
